scope: New offline review adapters and comparisons only. A citation is not validation or a substitute for license notices.

methods.definition: MNE FastICA (scikit-learn) or extended Infomax fitted to one explicitly selected, independently filtered continuous interval. Fixed seed, observed rank, effective fit interval, reference, iterations and removed components are recorded. No component is removed automatically.
methods.important_difference: MNE Infomax's iteration return does not reliably separate successful weight-change stopping from exhaustion; convergence is not asserted for that solver.

methods.definition: Actual mne-icalabel 0.10.0 ONNX inference, returning all seven class probabilities from a separately fitted extended-Infomax, common-average, 1–100 Hz decomposition with explicit electrode geometry. No automatic deletion.
methods.important_difference: Sampling rates at or below 200 Hz cannot support this intended band; those requests are explicitly unavailable rather than classified using invented high-frequency information.

methods.definition: Actual ASRpy 0.0.8 standard Euclidean ASR, calibrated on an explicitly reviewed continuous interval of at least 30 seconds. Each independent piece starts from a fresh calibrated model. One-second edge guards are unsupported. Not Riemannian ASR or a live-qualified route.
methods.important_difference: Requires isolated NumPy 1.26.4 because a real calibration test fails under NumPy 2. ASRpy's upstream documentation cites a patent; a permissive source license is not a comprehensive patent or legal clearance.

methods.definition: Regress centered EEG on calibration-standardized, explicitly paired EOG/EMG/motion references by least squares or declared ridge penalty; apply fixed weights on exactly aligned common support. Not iCanClean, causal inference or proof of artifact origin.

Mean/median Hann-window Welch PSD (50% overlap, constant detrending, density scaling) independently within supported pieces. Combine per-piece PSD by number of windows. The median output is not a global pooled median. Existing Theil–Sen aperiodic screening is unchanged.

Explicit independent event anchors; gap-free epochs; pre-event mean subtraction; ERP and pointwise trial bootstrap intervals; actual MNE complex Morlet wavelets, mean squared magnitude and inter-trial phase consistency. Five-sigma wavelet edge support is exposed. Power is not PSD.
methods.important_difference: Within-recording trial bootstrap is not participant uncertainty, simultaneous inference or independent replication.

methods.definition: PLV = absolute mean of complex phase differences; PAC = absolute mean of high-band amplitude times exp(i low-band phase), divided by mean amplitude. Independent fourth-order Butterworth/Hilbert operations per piece, with edge guards. Native/common-average sensitivity and circular-shift Monte Carlo controls are displayed.
methods.important_difference: This PAC is an amplitude-weighted vector measure, NOT Tort modulation index. Shift p-values are exploratory and unadjusted; stationary periodic structure, event timing, waveform shape, reference and artifacts can confound them.

methods.definition: Normalized entropy of ordinal patterns excluding tied vectors, and normalized entropy of Hann-Welch PSD. Common nonoverlapping fixed windows; no cross-gap concatenation or hidden resampling.
methods.important_difference: The tied-vector policy differs from the current worker's stable ordering. These quantities describe statistical structure, not consciousness or personal meaning.

methods.definition: Compare shipped PRAYCG fitting to actual Pycrostates 0.6.1 ModKMeans on identical calibration GFP peaks. Absolute-map Hungarian matching and separate non-overlapping held-out label agreement/GEV are reported. Record source-worker hash and seed.
methods.important_difference: Different initializations and stopping criteria remain visible; no numerical equivalence or canonical physiological-state identity is claimed.

methods.definition: One endpoint observation per participant/session/condition. Equal within-participant session averages, participant paired differences, exact sign flips up to 16 participants or plus-one Monte Carlo thereafter; participant bootstrap and explicit BH endpoint family.
methods.important_difference: Sign-flip inference assumes exchangeability/symmetry under the null; incompatible analysis versions and duplicate observations are rejected.

methods.definition: Fixed C=1 logistic regression, train-only StandardScaler, StratifiedGroupKFold holding participants entirely out; balanced accuracy per fold. No tuning or feature selection against test folds.

deferred.EEGPrep: Current 0.4.0 requires Python >=3.12; the reviewed Workbench runtime is Python 3.11. No EEGPrep capability is falsely substituted or represented as complete.
deferred.specialist_methods: Source localization, SOUND, AMICA and EEG-fMRI/TMS remain deliberately deferred pending their own prerequisites, data and validation.
